Interface Price

All Known Implementing Classes:
PriceJson
public interface Price
An Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v1 price entry, as returned by the price search POST /internetAccess/v1/prices/search.

Currency depends on the billing account. If a product (or part of it) is provided for free, it is listed with a price of 0. This is a read-only response view.
